race.description: Great Northern Brewing Co Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BOOMING BELIEF (8) is unlucky to still be a maiden hitting the top-five in all six outings to date and strikes a very winnable contest here. Strips fitter second-up from the spell and only needs some luck navigating from the wide draw to be playing a major role in the outcome. FAR AND WIDE (1) is at the races for the first time but brings NSW trial formlines to the table and won't need to be a superstar to be competitive against this lot. Has to be included in calculations. WATEGO'S BAY (7) put in a plain one two back but the three other career efforts have been good enough for a race of this nature. Top-three candidate. AUCHTERARDER (3) gets a stack of weight relief with the 3kg claim and may earn some minor money. DAVOS (2) next in line from the inside alley.
